# Overview

NCHA no-covariate main and exploratory models (21).

This is one of five split reports for De Young et al., "Graduate school confers
risk for mental illness and suicide." The report bodies share a common renderer
(`_report_body.Rmd`); only the set of models differs between files.

```{r define-models, include=FALSE}

POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS <- "C:/Users/Jonas Dora/OneDrive - UW/studies/2026_shackman/grad_mh/data/OUTPUTS"
rds_model <- function(label, filename) list(name = label, path = file.path(POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS, paste0(filename, ".rds")), format = "rds")
rdata_model <- function(label, filename) list(name = label, path = file.path(POSTERIOR_OUTPUTS, paste0(filename, ".RData")), format = "RData")

models_to_report <- list(
  rds_model("NCHA: Anxious (No Cov)", "anxious_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Depressed (No Cov)", "depressed_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Dx Anxiety (No Cov)", "dx_anxiety_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Dx Depression (No Cov)", "dx_depression_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Dx NSDUH Any (No Cov)", "dx_nsduh_any_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Suicidal Thinking (No Cov)", "dx_suic_thnk_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Suicide Attempt Linear (No Cov)", "dx_suic_try_no_cov_linear"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Suicide Attempt Linear+Quadratic (No Cov)", "dx_suic_try_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Global Health Dich (No Cov)", "global_health_dich_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Any psychiatric distress (No Cov)", "neg_emo_any_no_cov"),


  rds_model("NCHA: Hopeless (No Cov)", "hopeless_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Anger (No Cov)", "anger_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Lonely (No Cov)", "lonely_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Sad (No Cov)", "sad_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Exhausted Linear (No Cov)", "exhausted_item_no_cov_linear"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Exhausted Linear+Quadratic (No Cov)", "exhausted_item_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Overwhelmed Linear (No Cov)", "ovrwhlm_item_no_cov_linear"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Overwhelmed Linear+Quadratic (No Cov)", "ovrwhlm_item_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Dx Panic (No Cov)", "dx_panic_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Dx Bipolar (No Cov)", "dx_bipolar_no_cov"),
  rds_model("NCHA: Dx Schizophrenia (No Cov)", "dx_schizo_no_cov")
)
```
